title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Partition-Heal, Branch Reconciliation, and World-Receipt Extension

new_primitives.RECONCILIATION_RECORD: Binds common ancestor, all healed branch heads, imported receipts and resulting current state.
new_primitives.BRANCH_EVENT_DAG: Preserves post-partition events without flattening them into one fictional sequence.
new_primitives.CANONICAL_SHARED_COMMIT_SET: Shared-world commits whose authority/fence provenance was valid when accepted.
new_primitives.NONCANONICAL_CAUSAL_EFFECT_SET: Real world effects produced by invalid or stale authority; noncanonical does not mean unreal.
new_primitives.LOCAL_SCOPE_RECEIPT_SET: Bounded fail-safe effects valid only in local scope.
new_primitives.REPAIR_COMMIT_REF: Current valid commit used to compensate or recover from an invalid historical effect.

reconciliation_rule: Merge evidence, lineage and receipts; never merge by deleting the branch that makes the current story inconvenient.
world_receipt_rule: Authority validity and causal occurrence are separate dimensions: an invalidly authorized action may still have physically occurred and must remain visible.
obligation_rule: Uncommitted minority promises remain proposals; valid pre-partition and authoritative post-partition obligations are recomputed idempotently.
verification_requirements: heal a clean partition with one fenced writer and one local-failsafe branch
prove both branch histories survive reconciliation
prove authoritative shared commits are not duplicated
prove minority proposals are not retroactively promoted
inject a double-global-commit safety failure and preserve both world receipts
require a new valid repair commit instead of history deletion
canonical_lines: Reconciliation decides current authority; it does not rewrite past causality.
A receipt may prove that something happened even when another record proves it should not have been authorized.
The healed Janus inherits both the success and the failure of his branches.
